decisions: Change points use adjacent fixed-size frequency windows; the candidate period is the first period of the after-window.
Both upward and downward level shifts are reported when absolute mean delta reaches the configured minimum.
Each ChangePointEvent preserves before/after means, signed delta, direction and normalized strength for explainability.
The framework is deterministic, local and dependency-free; adaptive statistical models are deferred.
risks: Overlapping windows can produce more than one event around a prolonged transition; consolidation is deferred until signal semantics are specified.
The detector operates on frequency levels and assumes canonical, equally spaced observation periods.
